latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Video Maker Free Offline.

- Edit and export videos up to 500MB without cloud uploads or subscriptions.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM input, with 1080p MP4 export.
- Simple workflow: upload clips, describe edits, and download the finished video.
- Local session management with free anonymous token (100 credits, 7-day validity).
- Handles trimming, background music, text overlays, and batch processing.
- Fast server-side rendering for short clips, with visual timeline and versioning.
